decision.merge_recommendation: hold indexed promotion; keep MR draft

findings.title: Incomplete helpers could authorize overlapping staging
findings.before: A syntactically valid truncated pre-review helper accepted a root/staging conflict that fresh reference rejected.
findings.fix: Typed EOF capability markers and checks in both caller and helper entry points prevent incomplete or mixed helpers from gaining authority, including older callers.

findings.title: Worker bookkeeping and lost wakeups could strand retirement
findings.before: An admission bookkeeping MemoryError left active=1 with no native query running; a failed final notification could strand a draining owner.
findings.fix: Admission is inside the retirement finally; active work retires before optional accounting, and draining rechecks the fence with a bounded condition wait.

findings.title: Native acquisition and release errors crossed the cleanup boundary
findings.before: An interrupted successful open lost an uncounted handle; failed close accounting could still permit reference authorization.
findings.fix: Unpublished output handles are retired on foreign-call exceptions; uncertain close completion is latched as fatal, never retried, and never permits fallback authorization.

findings.title: Routine CI depended on experimental branch history
findings.before: Pinned git-show unit tests could fail after shallow checkout, squash merge or branch deletion.
findings.fix: Routine contract tests are self-contained; actual pinned old/helper/coordinator checks live in the explicit 115-case historical-source qualifier. CI no longer fetches all history for these unit tests.

repeat_timing_gate.source_note: Cleanup fixes measured before final constructor-only compatibility guards; the comparison/IO algorithm is unchanged. This failed gate is not replaced by later controls.

final_source_control_comparison.interpretation: descriptive single old/new samples under one continuing reference reader; no controlled regression or reliability claim

cross_version_upgrade.scope: isolated Windows cross-version checks; no consumer registry accessed

limits: The repeat timing gate failed; the index remains gated even though all sampled index answers agreed with reference.
Native queries must retire before root handles can close; blocked native IO can delay cancellation.
An uncertain failed close aborts the operation. Numeric handles are not retried because the OS may already have reused the value.
The consistency boundary remains past positive intervals with fresh negatives, not an atomic namespace freeze or protection against noncooperative record writers.
Capability, alias, journal and ordinary observation failures require complete safe cleanup before reference fallback.
Timing evidence covers this retained workload on one Windows/NTFS host with reused OS caches; it is not a universal latency guarantee.
privacy: anonymous consumer; no paths, names, tokens, ledger contents, raw manifests or raw logs are published
